description: Reviews API: Search Yelp businesses. Yelp businesses matching a name near a location, as `Entity` objects (`type` business). Yelp suggests a few businesses per query (usually 1 to 5), without rating; get the business for it. Price: 8 credits per call; failed calls are free. Paginated: pass pagination.next_cursor as `cursor` for the next page (each page is a new call).

location.description: City or address to search near (needed in practice)

name: reviews_yelp_businesses_search
title: Search Yelp businesses
